data.one_liner: Handles runtime permissions for Android and iOS with customizable dialogs
data.what_it_does: EasyPermissionValidator wraps the permission_handler plugin to request permissions at runtime. It provides a simple API and customizable messages or dialogs for each permission request.
use_when: When you need to request camera, location, contacts, microphone, or other device permissions
When you want to show a custom dialog or localized messages for permission requests
avoid_when: When you need platform‑specific permission handling beyond what permission_handler offers
When building a web or desktop‑only app that does not require runtime permissions
strengths: Simple API that hides permission_handler complexity
Supports custom dialogs and localized messages
Handles both Android and iOS permissions in one place
weaknesses: Relies on permission_handler, so any limitations of that plugin apply
No support for web or desktop platforms
data.setup_notes: Add required permissions to ios/Runner/Info.plist and android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml as listed in the README. No build_runner needed.
